Name: Litten Cat
Author: MetalShadowOverlord
Description:
Fan of Pokemon?
Hyped for Sun and Moon?
Love Litten? (#TeamLitten)

This is the mod for you!  Replace your cat with the black and red fire cat starter from the upcoming Pokemon Sun and Moon!

How to Install:

1. Navigate to: 'Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Animals'
2. Backup your original 'cat.xnb'
3. Place the downloaded 'cat.xnb' in the aforementioned folder

This is my first mod, so any and all feedback is appreciated!
